incident_text: Part of a five-storey apartment building has collapsed. Dust covers the street and neighbours say some residents may still be inside.

result.scene_summary: A scene of widespread structural damage showing collapsed buildings with debris scattered on the ground, surrounded by other damaged structures and vegetation.

observations.description: A building is completely collapsed, with its upper floors and walls reduced to piles of rubble and broken materials.
A tall pole stands upright near the collapsed structure, and other buildings are visible in the background, some showing signs of damage.
A green tree is visible behind the rubble, and some bushes and plants are growing around the debris.
A large white sack is visible near the foreground, resting on a concrete base.
A metal grate lies on the ground among the rubble.
A red-painted object (possibly a sign or panel) is partially visible on the damaged building.
